bible_verses.telugu: మన ప్రభువగు యేసుక్రీస్తు తండ్రియైన దేవుడు స్తుతింపబడునుగాక.
bible_verses.english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

bible_verses.telugu: యేసు ఆ చిరక  పుచ్చుకొనిసమాప్తమైనదని చెప్పి తల వంచి ఆత్మను అప్పగించెను.
bible_verses.english: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, 'It is finished.' With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

bible_verses.telugu: అయినను మునుపు దూరస్థులైన మీరు ఇప్పుడు క్రీస్తుయేసునందు క్రీస్తు రక్తమువలన సమీపస్థులై యున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near by the blood of Christ.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming into my darkest nights and bridging the impossible chasm between us. I praise You that Your work on the cross is completely finished and my future is secure in You. When fear or doubt creeps in, remind my heart that You are my living hope. Teach me to rest in Your boundless grace today and walk in the joy of Your salvation. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming into my darkest nights and bridging the impossible chasm between us. devotional.reflection_english: There was once a distance we could never cross on our own—a deep chasm of darkness and despair. Yet in His boundless mercy, Jesus reached across the divide and brought us near through His finished work on the cross. He didn't just give us a vague wish for the future; He became our living hope. Today, rest in the beauty of His complete grace and let your heart rejoice in the God who tore through the shadows to rescue you.
